sample_reviews: CRED previously had a very useful feature where, for each credit card, you could easily view the current spend and last statement spend from the card screen. Recently, this option seems to have been removed or is a bug. It made tracking credit-card expenses and comparing the current billing cycle with the previous statement extremely convenient. Please bring this feature back, or provide an equivalent way to view current cycle spend and previous statement spend for each card.
